chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
When you perform the funeral prayer over a woman, then stand at her head; and when you perform the funeral prayer over a man, then stand at his chest.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the male deceased over whom the prayer is performed
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the female deceased over whom the prayer is performed
key_terms.رَأْسِهَا: her head, the prescribed standing place in this context
key_terms.صَدْرِهِ: his chest, the prescribed standing place in this context

ai.seo_question: Where should one stand when performing salat over a female or male deceased person?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a jurisprudential ruling on where the person leading the funeral prayer should stand in relation to the deceased. It distinguishes between the woman and the man: at the woman's head and at the man's chest.
